arathi_refuge_quartermaster: Quartermaster Horg. These are the stores for Refuge Pointe. Orgrimmar sends me less than a third of what this garrison needs, so I make the rest or go without. Take what you need and no more than that.
weeping_moulin_keeper: Hesta Coldhand. This is the Moulin, the shaft at the mouth of the Weeping Ice, and I keep a small store here for anyone going deeper: potions, rope, lamp oil. I came down to study the ice three years ago and I have not finished.
gromgol_weaponsmith: Trag, weaponsmith of Grom'gol. My forge is on the east side of camp. Whetstones, flux, coal, bowstring and fletching. The damp here rusts steel overnight, so oil your blade every evening or buy another from me.
gromgol_quartermaster: Quartermaster Ghal. I issue the camp's potions and elixirs from the middle of Grom'gol. Everything on this table came off the airship and is counted. It is signed for when it goes out, and I expect the empties back.
gromgol_herbalist: Mossa, herbalist. I work at de west wall of Grom'gol. Elixirs brewed from what grows in dis jungle. Half of what grows out dere will kill you. I sell de other half.
gromgol_trader: Burg, trader. My stall is in the middle of camp. Parchment, thread, vials, glue, salt, dye - whatever came off the airship this week. If a crafter in Grom'gol needs it, they get it from me.
gromgol_provisioner: Nakka, provisioner. De cook-fire be on de south-west side of camp. Food, drink and bags for de road. Eat before you go south into de jungle. People forget, and den dey are hungry where nothing is safe to eat.
bootybay_trader: Nixxle, trader, on the upper quay of Booty Bay. Potions, mostly, and the strong ones. Everything on this shelf came off a boat that was going somewhere else, which is why I can sell it to you at all.
bootybay_shipping_clerk: Bexx, shipping clerk. My desk is in the middle of the upper quay. Parchment, glue, thread, curing salt, tanning supplies - the things a cargo needs before it sails. Give me the manifest, the weight and the destination, in that order.
bootybay_weapon_dealer: Sark. I deal in explosives, on the west side of the Bay where the Baron's bruisers do not look. Sapper charges, ember clusters, worse. I do not ask what they are for. I do ask for coin first.
bootybay_tavern_keeper: Marla. This is the Bay's tavern, in the middle of the west side. Wine, stew, broth and roast, and a hearth you can bind to. Drink it inside. What you spill out there, the tide keeps.
bootybay_fishmonger: Gurgle sell fish. South end of the Bay, by the water. Ribs, broth, salt for curing. Caught this morning. Some of it caught itself.
